0.long_answer: The virus in question is the Epstein–Barr virus (EBV). EBV is known for causing infectious mononucleosis, a condition that can sometimes lead to post-infectious chronic fatigue syndrome. Additionally, EBV has been implicated in various lymphoproliferative disorders, including angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma, where it plays a role in the pathogenesis of the disease.
